0 - if the row exists, a new row is not added and the existing row remains unchanged.\
1 - overwrite an existing row.

parameters.description:
Specifies whether to reload the services that use the specified dictionary:\
		0 - do not reload the services that use the specified dictionary.\
1 - reload the services that use the specified dictionary.\
\
Only used if the dictionary's kind is set to "dictionary". If the dictionary's kind is set to "table", parameters of services that use the dictionary are always updated.\
\
The following steps are usually used to reduce the number of service updates when multiple rows are modified:
- When adding, changing, or deleting several rows, perform all operations except for the last one with needReload=0.
- Perform the last operation on dictionary row without specifying needReload, i.e. the use default value needReload=1\
\
For a single operation with a row, the needReload parameter value is not required to update the services that use the dictionary.
parameters.name: needReload
